pictures.scene: Aivazovsky, Chaos, the Creation of the World — a vast unsettled sky of rolling cloud filling most of the picture, the upper half washed in warm pale gold and grey violet, a brilliant white burst of light breaking through near the top with a small radiant figure standing in the middle of it, its arms opened wide and trailing streams of light, a huge dark cloud piled up directly beneath the light and spreading out sideways like wings, banks of soft brown grey vapour rolling away to left and right, and far below the first sea heaving in the half light, long waves running in with white crests, the water black in the hollows, and a single broad track of reflected gold laid straight down the middle of it to the foot of the picture, in the beginning was the word, and the word was with god, and the word was god, …
pictures.name: pd_aivazovsky_chaos_the_creation_of_the_world

pictures.scene: Holman Hunt, The Light of the World — Christ standing alone at night outside a long unopened door, filling the whole height of the picture, His long auburn hair and short beard falling over His shoulders and a pale gold halo ringing His head, His face turned quietly out toward us, a white robe reaching to His bare feet under a dark richly embroidered mantle clasped at the breast with a broad jewelled band set with red and green stones, His right hand lifted to knock and His left hand holding out a round metal lantern pierced with little stars and circles, the candle inside burning warm orange and throwing its glow up over His sleeve and across the scarlet lining of His cloak, the door beside Him grown over with ivy, dead stalks and brambles so that it clearly has not been opened in a long time, fallen apples lying half hidden in the weeds at His feet, and behind Him a cold blue night orchard of bare crooked branches, in him was life, and that life was the light of men, the light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it, …
pictures.name: pd_holman_hunt_the_light_of_the_world

pictures.scene: Bruegel, The Sermon of Saint John the Baptist — a huge crowd packed together in a dark wood to hear a preacher, the massive trunk of an old tree rising up the left edge and heavy black branches closing over the top, the preacher standing well back among them in a plain brown gown, lean and bearded, one hand raised and the other pointing away to the side, a bearded man in a red cloak and another in blue green listening close beside him, and in front of them hundreds of faces turned his way, countrywomen in white linen caps, men in black hats and hoods, a woman in a red jacket with a green skirt high at the left, a child in an orange cap held up to see, a man perched in the fork of the tree above the heads, two more climbing a trunk at the right, and in the near foreground the backs of the latecomers, a man in a pale cream cloak, one in a yellow straw hat, a broad woman in a cream mantle with red stripes at the right edge, a traveller with a staff and a basket slung on his back, a dark red cloth hanging on the tree beside him, there came a man who was sent from god, his name was john, …
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_sermon_of_saint_john_the_baptist

pictures.scene: Church, Morning — a still river winding away between wooded banks at first light, the whole picture filled with warm golden haze, the small white disc of the sun just risen in the middle of the sky and its glow spreading out until the far distance dissolves in light, a long bright column of reflection running straight down the water to the bottom edge, dark leafy branches hanging into the top corner at the left and a tall tree leaning over the bank at the right, thickets of wet foliage crowding both shores and dropping their reflections into the still water, a broad feathery palm leaf in the near corner, a line of small white birds skimming low over the surface on the right, and far off in the mist a single figure standing in the shallows, the true light who gives light to every man was coming into the world, …
pictures.name: pd_church_morning

pictures.scene: Bogdanov-Belsky, At the School Doors — a ragged country boy standing in an open doorway looking in at a village school, seen from behind with his fair hair cut straight across and his face turned away in shadow, leaning his shoulder against the painted door frame, a patched and frayed brown coat tied at the waist, a coarse white satchel hanging across his chest and a cloth bundle knotted onto a cord over his shoulder, torn whitish trousers, his legs bound round and round with strips of cloth and old bast sandals laced on his feet, both hands resting on a long thin walking stick with his cap folded over the top of it, and beyond him the lit schoolroom, a row of small children bent over a bench with their heads together, a blackboard on a wooden easel, a map and a printed notice hung on the plank wall, a hanging oil lamp and two small icons in the corner, and a wide bare board floor between him and them, he came to his own, and his own did not receive him, …
pictures.name: pd_bogdanov_belsky_at_school_doors

pictures.scene: De Wet, Christ Blessing the Children — Christ seated on a low step in the shadowed entrance of a great stone building, a soft gold halo ringing His dark hair, His head bent kindly down and one hand laid against His breast, a plain cream robe falling to His feet under a deep rose red mantle, and all around Him a press of mothers and small children brought up close, a young woman in a white bodice and blue skirt kneeling at the left with a baby in her arm and another child pressed against her, a little girl in a yellow gown with a striped cap kneeling right in front of Him with her hands joined in prayer, a boy in grey kneeling and looking up into His face, a fair haired child in blue leaning against His knee at the right, a tiny child in a cap being held forward at the lower right, a small boy in a red cap seen from behind sitting on the pale stone floor in the near corner, a grey bearded man in a brown cloak standing above them watching, and more heads and shoulders crowding in from the dark at both edges, but to all who did receive him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of god, …
pictures.name: pd_dewet_christus_zegent_kinderen

pictures.scene: Georges de La Tour, The Adoration of the Shepherds — a newborn child lying swaddled in white linen in a shallow basket of straw at the bottom of a dark stable, His small face asleep and softly lit, and bending over Him in the candlelight a close ring of country people, a young shepherd at the left in a dark jerkin holding a long staff, a second shepherd behind him in a soft cap smiling down, a woman in a white headcloth and grey bodice with red sleeves holding out a shallow earthen bowl, an old bearded herdsman at the right in an orange cloak with a pale band across it, and in front of him a hand cupped around a single candle flame, its glow spreading up over the faces and leaving the rafters above in warm darkness, a thick fleeced ewe pushing her nose in from the left toward the straw, a fold of deep scarlet cloak filling the near corner, and the whole room silent and brown except where the light touches, the word became flesh and made his dwelling among us, we have seen his glory, …
pictures.name: pd_latour_adoration_shepherds

pictures.scene: Philippe de Champaigne, Moses Presenting the Tablets of the Law — an old man filling almost the whole frame against a plain black ground, his long grey and gold hair falling to his shoulders and two short rays of light standing up from his forehead like horns, a broad soft beard spreading over his chest, his brows drawn together and his lips parted as though he has just spoken, his eyes turned straight out at us, a brilliant deep blue mantle over a robe of gold and dark blue brocade worked all over with embroidered leaves, a pink sleeve edged with blue showing at his wrist, a slender gilt staff laid diagonally across him from shoulder to hand, and held upright in both hands two tall grey stone tablets covered in close handwritten commandments numbered one after another down their faces, one hand gripping the top edge of the stone and the other steadying it on a plain stone ledge at the bottom, for the law was given through moses, grace and truth came through jesus christ, …
pictures.name: pd_de_champaigne_moses_presenting_the_tablets_of_the_law

pictures.scene: Durer, Saint John before God and the Elders — a black and white woodcut of a vision opening in the sky above a quiet countryside, at the top a bearded figure enthroned in heaven holding a sword and a book, a ring of seven burning lamps hung in the air around His head, a lamb standing beside the throne, and crowding in on every side a great circle of white bearded elders in crowns and long robes seated on benches, some with hands lifted and some bowed, the four living creatures with wings between them, long straight rays of light cut as fine parallel lines streaming out behind them all, below the throne a banked wall of rolling cloud drawn in curling outlines, and standing on that cloud in the middle a long haired man in a plain mantle led forward by a crowned elder who lays a hand on his arm and points him up toward the throne, while far beneath, under the cloud, a wide landscape runs away to the horizon, a walled town with towers on a hill at the left, a tall gabled house and a round tower among the trees in the middle, leafy woods filling both sides, reeds and tufts of grass in the near foreground, no one has ever seen god, but the one and only son, who is himself god and is at the father's side, has made him known, …
pictures.name: pd_durer_saint_john_before_god_and_the_elders

pictures.scene: Allston, Elijah in the Desert — a great dead tree standing alone in a stony wilderness, its pale bare trunk rising the whole height of the left side and one long leafless limb reaching right out across the sky with broken twigs at its end, a black raven perched on the stump of a lower branch, behind it a broad sky of heaped grey and white cloud with blue breaking through at the top, a line of snow covered peaks catching the light far off in the middle distance, a dark broken cliff coming down on the right, a wide floor of brown rock and dried mud in the foreground with a still pool lying in the hollow of it and scattered boulders, a fallen bleached root curling up out of the ground, a second raven flying low across the rocks with food held in its beak, and at the lower right an old prophet in a pale grey blue robe seated on the ground with his bare head bowed, his hands lifted to take what the bird brings him, then who are you, they inquired, are you elijah, he said, i am not, …
pictures.name: pd_allston_elijah_in_the_desert

pictures.scene: Geertgen tot Sint Jans, John the Baptist in the Wilderness — a barefoot man sitting alone on a grassy bank in an open green country, his long brown hair falling past his shoulders and a thin ring of gold rays round his head, his cheek propped on one hand and his eyes turned away in thought, a coarse dark brown tunic belted at the waist and a heavy blue mantle wrapped over his shoulder and spilling out across the grass in deep folds all around him, one bare foot stretched out in front, a small white lamb lying on the turf at his left with its own little halo of rays, a narrow stream running through mossy stones beside it, and behind him a wide quiet landscape, rolling grass banks, clumps of fern and thistle, slender young trees with feathery tops, deer and rabbits in the field, a magpie on a bush, flocks of birds crossing a pale blue sky, and far off beyond the woods the towers of a distant town in the haze, i am a voice of one calling in the wilderness, make straight the way for the lord, …
pictures.name: pd_geertgen_woestijn

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Two Old Men Disputing — two aged men arguing over a book in a dark brown room, the one at the right sitting back in a wooden armchair in a loose white robe, his head bald on top with white hair round the sides and a long white beard spreading down his chest, his eyes fixed on the other man and his mouth open in answer, one hand resting on the arm of the chair and the other spread flat on the open page, the one at the left seen from behind and in lost profile, grey haired, leaning forward in a heavy brown and dull orange cloak that falls in great folds to the floor, his finger pressed on a line of the book he is holding out, more closed books stacked at his knee, the seated man's bare feet on the dark boards, a heavy table at the right with a brass candlestick and a pale cloth hanging off it, and the whole wall behind them lost in warm shadow, asked him, why then do you baptize, if you are not the christ, nor elijah, nor the prophet, …
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_two_old_men

pictures.scene: Velazquez, The Waterseller of Seville — a weathered old water carrier standing in a dark doorway handing a drink to a boy, his lined face in profile with a short grey streaked beard and his eyes lowered to the cup, a coarse tan cloak worn through and split at the shoulder and elbow so the white shirt shows beneath, one broad brown hand gripping the handle of a huge pale clay jar that stands in the very front of the picture, its round belly ringed with turning marks and beaded with drops of water, a second great jar at the left on a wooden stand, and the boy on the other side of it in a dark coat with a wide white collar, his face lit and his lips parted, taking the stem of a tall clear glass of water with both hands, and half lost in the shadow between them a third man tilting an earthen cup to his mouth as he drinks, the whole room behind them a plain warm darkness, i baptize with water, john replied, but among you stands one you do not know, …
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_waterseller

pictures.scene: Zurbaran, Agnus Dei — a young white ram lying on a plain grey stone slab against a completely black ground, nothing else in the picture at all, his legs folded under him and bound together with a cord so that he cannot rise, his head laid over on its side with the muzzle hanging just past the edge of the stone, the eye half closed and quiet, the pink nose and the soft lips picked out in the light, one curled horn coming forward over the cheek and the other turning back into the fleece, the wool painted curl by curl in warm cream and grey where the light falls on his back and shoulder and sinking into shadow behind, and the light coming from one side only so that the little body glows out of the darkness, look, the lamb of god, who takes away the sin of the world, …
pictures.name: pd_zurbaran_agnus_dei

pictures.scene: Philips Koninck, River Landscape — a whole country opened out under an enormous sky, towering banks of grey and violet cloud piled up across the top with white sunlit heads and strips of clear blue showing between them, two small birds crossing the middle of it, a very low pale horizon far away where the land and a broad sheet of water meet with tiny sails on it, and below that a wide plain running back for miles in bands, dark woods and hedges, green fields, a winding creek lying bright among the reeds, a red roofed farm among trees, a low white house with a garden wall at the left, a stand of tall pale trees, a sandy track curving up out of the foreground over a dune of rough grass and scrub, two men riding away along it on brown horses with a dog trotting ahead, and a little further on a traveller with a long pole and a woman walking beside him, all of them very small in the great width of the land, the reason i came baptizing with water was that he might be revealed to israel, …
pictures.name: pd_koninck_rivierlandschap

pictures.scene: Millais, The Return of the Dove to the Ark — two girls standing close together on a floor of loose dry straw inside a dark wooden ark, a white dove held between them, the taller girl at the left in a long plain dark green gown with her auburn hair falling straight past her shoulders, her eyes closed and her face lifted in quiet relief, one arm reaching across to steady the bird, the younger girl at the right wrapped in a heavy creamy white mantle over a deep purple sleeve, leaning her cheek right down onto the dove's soft breast feathers and kissing it, her bare fingers holding up between them the small green olive sprig the bird has brought back, the dove calm in their hands with one wing folded, its white plumage the brightest thing in the picture, the rough straw spread all across the floor and piled in a heap at the left, and behind them nothing but the black timber of the ark's wall, then john testified, i saw the spirit descending from heaven like a dove and resting on him, …
pictures.name: pd_millais_the_return_of_the_dove_to_the_ark

pictures.scene: Giovanni Bellini, Christ Blessing — Christ standing close to us against an evening sky, risen and alive, His long dark hair falling in damp strands over His shoulders and a plaited crown of thorns still pressed down on His brow with a few fine gold rays springing out behind it, His eyes wide and turned slightly away, His lips parted as though about to speak, a plain white robe gathered in soft vertical folds with a broad band of worked gold embroidery at the neck and at each shoulder and cuff, His right hand lifted beside His head with the fingers drawn in to bless, His left hand laid across a heavy black bound book clasped with a metal strap and stamped with gold ornament, the dark mark of a nail wound showing in the back of that hand, a narrow opening in the robe over His breast where the spear wound was, and behind Him a deep blue sky with long grey clouds drawn across it and a glimpse of low trees and quiet country at the bottom corners, i have seen and testified that this is the son of god, …
pictures.name: pd_bellini_blessing_christ

pictures.scene: Corot, The Road — a broad country road climbing over the brow of a hill, its pale pink sandy surface worn into ruts and lit all down the middle, a tall dark green tree standing the whole height of the right hand side with its branches spreading over and a mass of woodland below it, a slender young tree and a low garden wall with a white cottage behind it on the left, a hedge and a strip of green pasture, a single figure walking up the road in a dark skirt and a red shawl with a white bundle under one arm and a pale cap on her head, a small dog in the grass beside her, the land dropping away beyond the crest into a wide hazy plain with roofs and a far off spire, and above it all a high soft sky of blue and drifting white cloud, and when the two disciples heard him say this, they followed jesus, …
pictures.name: pd_corot_road

pictures.scene: Pieter de Hooch, The Courtyard of a House in Delft — the little brick yard behind a town house on a bright still afternoon, a worn red and white brick archway at the left with a carved head on the keystone and an old lettered stone tablet set in the wall above it, and through the arch a swept passage leading out to the street where a woman in a dark jacket and a red skirt stands with her back to us looking away toward the water, on the right a doorway under a lean to roof hung with a vine whose thin branches and pale yellow leaves spread across the top of the picture, a heavy plank door standing open on its hinge, a wooden ladder leaning against the post, and coming down the step a young woman in a blue skirt and a dark apron with a white kerchief crossed at her neck and a white linen cap, carrying a shallow dish in one hand and holding a small girl by the other, the child in a yellow skirt and pale smock with a little white cap, looking up into her face, a wooden pail and a broom lying on the worn brick paving in the near corner, and a patch of pale sky with soft cloud above the garden wall, come and see, he replied, so they went and saw where he was staying, and spent that day with him, …
pictures.name: pd_de_hooch_courtyard_of_a_house_in_delft

pictures.scene: Van Dyck, Lord John Stuart and His Brother Lord Bernard Stuart — two young brothers standing together on a flight of pale stone steps against a dark brown wall, the elder at the left leaning his elbow on the stone balustrade, his long fair hair falling to his shoulders over a wide white lace collar, a slashed gold satin doublet with rows of small buttons and full sleeves, dark red breeches, and loose buff boots turned down over gold fringed hose, his face calm and turned straight out at us, the younger standing on the step below and half turned away, his head twisted back over his shoulder to look at us, a mass of curling light brown hair, a silver white satin doublet and a silvery cloak slung over one shoulder with a deep blue lining and a lace edge, bright blue velvet breeches trimmed with silver lace, pale leather boots with lace frills at the knee, one gloved hand holding the other glove against his hip, the two of them standing very close and plainly of one family, he first found his brother simon and told him, we have found the messiah, …
pictures.name: pd_van_dyck_stuart_brothers

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Saint Peter Preaching — a white-haired Peter in a blue tunic and a great orange cloak standing barefoot at the left with his hand raised in speech, a packed crowd of listening men and women pressed close on the right beneath a green wooded mountain, andrew brought him to jesus, who looked at him and said, you are simon son of john, you will be called cephas, …
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_saint_peter_preaching

pictures.scene: Brueghel, Christ in the Storm on the Sea of Galilee — a small open fishing boat crowded with frightened men in red, yellow and pink tossed on a dark green lake under a heavy worked storm sky, one man hauling at the sail and other sails scattered far off toward a rocky headland, now philip was from bethsaida, the same town as andrew and peter, …
pictures.name: pd_brueghel_galilea

pictures.scene: Hirszenberg, Head of a Jew — the head and shoulders of an old man in a black cap and a dark coat filling the whole frame, his long white beard catching the light and his lined face turned a little down in quiet thought against a plain warm brown ground, when jesus saw nathanael approaching, he said of him, here is a true israelite, in whom there is no deceit, …
pictures.name: pd_hirszenberg_head_of_a_jew

pictures.scene: Van Gogh, Olive Trees — old olive trees with knotted writhing trunks and blue and green crowns spread across the top of a sunlit orchard, the sloping ground beneath them laid in thick orange, yellow and pale green strokes and one small figure in red stooping among the roots, before philip called you, i saw you under the fig tree, …
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_olive_trees

pictures.scene: Willmann, Landscape with the Dream of Jacob — a great dark wooded hillside opening on the left into a shaft of pale light down which robed angels climb and descend a long ladder, Jacob asleep in red at the foot of it and one winged figure in white and gold striding out toward him, you will all see heaven open and the angels of god ascending and descending on the son of man, …
pictures.name: pd_willmann_landscape_with_the_dream_of_jacob

lines.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. He was with God in the beginning.
Through Him all things were made, and without Him nothing was made that has been made.
In Him was life, and that life was the light of men.
The Light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
There came a man who was sent from God. His name was John.
He came as a witness to testify about the Light, so that through him everyone might believe.
He himself was not the Light, but he came to testify about the Light.
The true Light who gives light to every man was coming into the world.
He was in the world, and though the world was made through Him, the world did not recognize Him.
He came to His own, and His own did not receive Him.
But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God,
children born not of blood, nor of the desire or will of man, but born of God.
The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us. We have seen His glory, the glory of the one and only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
John testified concerning Him. He cried out, saying, This is He of whom I said, He who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.
From His fullness we have all received grace upon grace.
For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is Himself God and is at the Father's side, has made Him known.
And this was John's testimony when the Jews of Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him, Who are you?
He did not refuse to confess, but openly declared, I am not the Christ.
Then who are you? they inquired. Are you Elijah? He said, I am not. Are you the Prophet? He answered, No.
So they said to him, Who are you? We need an answer for those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?
John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet: I am a voice of one calling in the wilderness, Make straight the way for the Lord.
Then the Pharisees who had been sent
asked him, Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?
I baptize with water, John replied, but among you stands One you do not know.
He is the One who comes after me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.
All this happened at Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
This is He of whom I said, A man who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.
I myself did not know Him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that He might be revealed to Israel.
Then John testified, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove and resting on Him.
I myself did not know Him, but the One who sent me to baptize with water told me, The man on whom you see the Spirit descend and rest is He who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.
I have seen and testified that this is the Son of God.
The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.
When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, Look, the Lamb of God!
And when the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.
Jesus turned and saw them following. What do you want? He asked. They said to Him, Rabbi which means Teacher, where are You staying?
Come and see, He replied. So they went and saw where He was staying, and spent that day with Him. It was about the tenth hour.
Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, was one of the two who heard John's testimony and followed Jesus.
He first found his brother Simon and told him, We have found the Messiah which is translated as Christ.
Andrew brought him to Jesus, who looked at him and said, You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas which is translated as Peter.
The next day Jesus decided to set out for Galilee. Finding Philip, He told him, Follow Me.
Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the same town as Andrew and Peter.
Philip found Nathanael and told him, We have found the One Moses wrote about in the Law, the One the prophets foretold, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
Can anything good come from Nazareth? Nathanael asked. Come and see, said Philip.
When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, He said of him, Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit.
How do You know me? Nathanael asked. Jesus replied, Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.
Rabbi, Nathanael answered, You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!
Jesus said to him, Do you believe just because I told you I saw you under the fig tree? You will see greater things than these.
Then He declared, Truly, truly, I tell you, you will all see heaven open and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.
